note: Steele County ND says it is not involved in zoning and refers zoning questions to townships and cities. Its GIS viewer (portico.mygisonline.com, viewer=steelend) is a Sidwell parcel viewer with no zoning service found. The one city zoning source found, East Hope (cityofeasthope.com), publishes its zoning map only as PDFs (Ordinance 292, Resolution 156, Exhibit A). No ArcGIS REST zoning layer exists for Steele County or its cities (Finley, Hope, East Hope); ArcGIS searches returned none. Zoning is published only as PDF maps, so viewer-only.
